title: One AI Chat Uses 500 Milliliters Of Water
hook: Your long AI chat can consume 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Invisible computing still competes for a very visible shared resource.
question: Should AI disclose its water use?

segments.say: Microsoft's water use rose from 1.95 million cubic meters in 2017 to 6.4 in 2022.
Google used 21.2 million cubic meters versus Microsoft's 6.4 million.
One 20-50-prompt AI conversation uses about 500 milliliters, equal to one water bottle.
